notes.title: Official Publisher Announcement
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44820891/a0764cbdee5e7dd4588f080fef118bd5b66c36c8.png"][/img][/p][p]Developing a game for the esports community has been our goal from day one. More importantly, we aim to deliver not just a game, but a high-quality product that showcases what esports truly means to us as a company.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2749950/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][i]For those of you who may not know, working with a game publishing platform like indie.io[/i] [i]greatly helps indie developers focus on game development while they handle all the behind-the-scenes magic. From helping manage store pages to crafting marketing campaigns and even helping the game shine at both digital and live events, indie.io helps in all the aspects that indie developers often struggle with alone.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]The reason we’ve teamed up with [url="http://indie.io/"]indie.io[/url] is simple: to bring Esports Manager to more gamers.We believe this is a huge milestone in our company’s history and the start of something truly amazing.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kMezTkn1awk"][/dynamiclink]Follow us on our socials, join our Discord, and be sure to wishlist and follow the game to stay up to date with future news![/p][p]Don't forget to check out [url="http://indie.io/"]indie.io[/url]'s Steam Publisher Page right here - [url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/indieio"]https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/indieio[/url]! They have great titles over there.[/p]

notes.title: Development Blog #16
notes.content:
Hello guys, today we are going to talk a little bit more about "Simulation". So we've developed 64 default tactics that you can use during simulation. The maps are:

1) Mirage 
2) Dust || 
3) Vertigo
4) Ancient
5) Inferno 
6) Nuke 
7) Anubis

Check out the full development blog [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/104930172]here[/url].
